items.en: Attention, please. The 10:12 rapid service for Takao will depart from track 3, not track 5.
items.ja: お知らせします。10時12分発の快速高尾行きは、5番線ではなく3番線から発車します。
items.speaker: judy
items.note: not の後は訂正前。track＝番線（米・日本の英語）
items.tts: Attention, please. The ten twelve rapid service for Takao will depart from track three, not track five.

items.en: Ladies and gentlemen, we apologize for the delay. Due to an earlier signal problem, we're running about 15 minutes behind schedule.
items.ja: 遅れて申し訳ございません。先ほどの信号トラブルのため、この列車は約15分遅れて運行しております。
items.speaker: raymond
items.note: behind schedule＝遅れ。15は-teenが長い。50はフィフディ
items.tts: Ladies and gentlemen, we apologize for the delay. Due to an earlier signal problem, we're running about fifteen minutes behind schedule.

items.en: This is the final boarding call for passenger Sato on flight 212 to Chicago. Please proceed immediately to gate 64.
items.ja: シカゴ行き212便にご搭乗のサトウ様、最終のご案内です。至急64番搭乗口へお越しください。
items.speaker: orville
items.note: final call＝最終案内。便名と搭乗口を混同しない
items.tts: This is the final boarding call for passenger Sato on flight two-twelve to Chicago. Please proceed immediately to gate sixty-four.

items.en: Passengers on flight 838 to San Francisco, please note your departure gate has changed. The flight will now leave from gate 71.
items.ja: サンフランシスコ行き838便のお客様、出発ゲートが変更になりました。71番ゲートからの出発となります。
items.speaker: coco
items.note: now leave from の後が新しいゲート
items.tts: Passengers on flight eight-three-eight to San Francisco, please note your departure gate has changed. The flight will now leave from gate seventy-one.

items.en: Boarding for flight 409 to Singapore will begin at 7:50. That's ten minutes earlier than shown on your boarding pass.
items.ja: シンガポール行き409便の搭乗は7時50分に始まります。搭乗券の表示より10分早くなります。
items.speaker: wilbur
items.note: earlier than shown＝券の時刻より前。計算させるひっかけ
items.tts: Boarding for flight four-oh-nine to Singapore will begin at seven fifty. That's ten minutes earlier than shown on your boarding pass.

items.en: For billing and payments, press 1. To report a lost or stolen card, press 3. For all other inquiries, please hold.
items.ja: ご請求とお支払いは1を、カードの紛失・盗難は3を、その他のお問い合わせはそのままお待ちください。
items.speaker: maple
items.note: メニューは用件が先、番号が後に来る
items.tts: For billing and payments, press one. To report a lost or stolen card, press three. For all other inquiries, please hold.
items.ask: カードをなくした。何番？

items.en: All of our representatives are currently assisting other callers. You are caller number 6, and your estimated wait time is 12 minutes.
items.ja: ただいま担当者はすべて他のお客様の対応中です。お客様は6番目で、お待ち時間はおよそ12分です。
items.speaker: diana
items.note: caller number 6 は順番。wait time の後が時間
items.tts: All of our representatives are currently assisting other callers. You are caller number six, and your estimated wait time is twelve minutes.

items.en: Hi, it's Karen from Bayside Dental, just confirming your appointment on Thursday the 14th at 3:15. Give us a call if you need to change it.
items.ja: ベイサイド歯科のカレンです。14日木曜、3時15分のご予約の確認です。変更があればお電話ください。
items.speaker: whitney
items.note: 日付→時刻の順。3:15 の fifteen に引っぱられない
items.tts: Hi, it's Karen from Bayside Dental, just confirming your appointment on Thursday the fourteenth at three fifteen. Give us a call if you need to change it.

items.en: Hey, it's Sam. Our seats are in section 214. Wait, no, sorry, 241. See you at the game!
items.ja: サムだよ。席はセクション214…いや、ごめん、241。じゃあ球場で！
items.speaker: kid-cat
items.note: sorry の後が訂正。後ろの2桁が入れ替わる
items.tts: Hey, it's Sam. Our seats are in section two-fourteen. Wait, no, sorry — two-forty-one. See ya at the game!
items.ask: 席は どの セクション？

items.en: Thank you for shopping with us today. The store will be closing in 15 minutes, at 8 p.m. Please bring your final purchases to the registers.
items.ja: 本日はご来店ありがとうございます。あと15分、午後8時で閉店いたします。お会計はレジへお持ちください。
items.speaker: label
items.note: in 15 minutes＝あと15分。閉店時刻は at の後
items.tts: Thank you for shopping with us today. The store will be closing in fifteen minutes, at eight p.m. Please bring your final purchases to the registers.

items.en: Shoppers, for the next 30 minutes only, all winter coats on the third floor are 40% off.
items.ja: お客様へ、これから30分間限定で、3階の冬物コートがすべて40%オフです。
items.speaker: mabel
items.note: thirty（時間）と forty（割引）。3階の third も混ざる
items.tts: Shoppers, for the next thirty minutes only, all winter coats on the third floor are forty percent off.

items.en: A typhoon warning remains in place for Kanto. Expect heavy rain from about 2 p.m., with gusts of up to 90 kilometers an hour, easing to 40 by Thursday morning.
items.ja: 関東に台風の警報が続いています。午後2時ごろから大雨、最大瞬間風速は90キロ、木曜朝には40キロまで弱まる見込みです。
items.speaker: blathers
items.note: gusts of up to＝最大瞬間で〜。easing to は弱まった後
items.tts: A typhoon warning remains in place for Kanto. Expect heavy rain from about two p.m., with gusts of up to ninety kilometers an hour, easing to forty by Thursday morning.

items.en: Due to an accident at Shinjuku, Chuo Line services are suspended between Tokyo and Mitaka. Passengers are advised to use Tokyo Metro services instead.
items.ja: 新宿駅での事故のため、中央線は東京〜三鷹間で運転を見合わせています。東京メトロをご利用ください。 → 別の路線で行く。
items.speaker: goldie
choices: Wait on the platform for the next train.
items.note: suspended＝運転見合わせ。instead の前が代わりの手段

items.en: The doors on this side will not open at the next station. Please use the doors on the opposite side.
items.ja: 次の駅では、こちら側のドアは開きません。反対側のドアをご利用ください。 → 反対側のドアから降りる。
items.speaker: maple
choices: Get off on the other side.
The doors on this side are broken.
items.note: opposite side＝反対側。will not open を聞き逃さない
items.focus: use the doors on the opposite side
items.ask: なんの アナウンス？

items.en: Due to high winds, trains on this line are running at reduced speed, and some trains may be canceled on short notice.
items.ja: 強風のため、この路線の列車は速度を落として運転しており、一部の列車は急に運休となる場合があります。 → 遅れていて、運休もありうる。
items.speaker: julian
choices: Trains are slower, and some may not run.
All trains are canceled for today.
Trains are running on time despite the wind.
items.note: due to＝〜のため。on short notice＝直前に
items.ask: いま どんな じょうきょう？

items.en: Thanks for calling Metro Water. Our office is now closed. If you're reporting a burst pipe or a water outage, please stay on the line.
items.ja: メトロ水道にお電話ありがとうございます。営業時間外です。水道管の破損や断水のご連絡は、このままお待ちください。 → 切らずに待つ。
items.speaker: cherry
choices: Hang up and send an email.
items.note: stay on the line＝切らずに待つ。closed で切らない
items.ask: 水道管が こわれた。どうする？

items.en: Hey, it's me. Look, I know it's short notice, and you can totally say no, but is there any chance you could give me a ride to the airport Saturday morning? My flight's at seven. Anyway, text me.
items.ja: おれだよ。急で悪いし、断ってくれていいんだけど、土曜の朝、空港まで車で送ってもらえないかな？飛行機が7時なんだ。じゃ、メッセージして。 → 土曜の朝、空港まで送ってほしい。
items.speaker: punchy
choices: He wants a ride to the airport on Saturday.
His flight on Saturday was canceled.
He wants you to fly with him on Saturday.
items.note: 前置きが長く、用件は but の後。ride＝車で送ること
items.tts: Hey, it's me. Look, I know it's short notice, an' you can totally say no, but is there any chance you could gimme a ride to the airport Saturday mornin'? My flight's at seven. Anyway, text me.
items.focus: give me a ride to the airport
items.ask: でんわの ようけんは？

items.en: This is a test of the building fire alarm system. No action is required. Please continue with your normal activities.
items.ja: これはビルの火災報知設備の試験です。対応は必要ありません。そのまま通常どおりお過ごしください。 → 何もしなくていい。
items.speaker: tom-nook
items.note: No action is required＝何もしなくてよい

items.en: We're currently experiencing a high volume of calls. You may find it quicker to visit our website.
items.ja: ただいまお電話が大変混み合っております。ウェブサイトのほうが早い場合がございます。 → つまり、電話はかなり待つ。
items.speaker: diana
choices: You'll probably have to wait a long time on the phone.
The website is down right now.
They'll call you back very soon.
items.note: high volume of calls＝混雑。遠回しに「待つよ」

items.en: Please stand back from the platform edge. The next train will not be stopping at this station.
items.ja: ホームの端から下がってください。次の電車はこの駅に停まりません。 → つまり、電車が通過する。
items.speaker: judy
choices: A train is going to pass through without stopping.
The next train has been canceled.
The platform is closed for repairs.
items.note: not stopping＝通過。運休ではない

items.en: Please allow customers to exit before boarding.
items.ja: ご乗車の前に、お降りになるお客様をお待ちください。 → つまり、降りる人が先。
items.speaker: mabel
choices: Board through the front doors only.
Get on quickly, the doors are closing.
items.note: exit before boarding＝降りる人が先。board＝乗る

items.en: This is the last train to Newark this evening. There is no further service tonight.
items.ja: これが今夜のニューアーク行き最終列車です。今夜はこの後の運行はありません。 → つまり、これを逃すともう電車はない。
items.speaker: raymond
choices: If you miss this one, there are no more trains tonight.
This train will stop before Newark tonight.
The next train to Newark leaves from another track.
items.note: no further service＝この後はない

items.en: Hi, it's Tom from the management office. Just a heads-up, the plumber's running late tomorrow. I wouldn't hold your breath before lunch.
items.ja: 管理会社のトムです。念のため、明日は配管工が遅れそうです。お昼前はあまり期待しないでください。 → つまり、午前中は来ない。
items.speaker: tom-nook
choices: The plumber probably won't come in the morning.
The plumber will come early tomorrow.
You should call the plumber before lunch.
items.note: don't hold your breath＝期待しないで
items.tts: Hi, it's Tom from the management office. Just a heads-up, the plumber's runnin' late tomorrow. I wouldn't hold your breath before lunch.

items.en: At this time, we'd like to invite passengers seated in rows 30 and higher to board. All other passengers, please remain seated.
items.ja: ただいまより、30列目以降のお客様のご搭乗をご案内いたします。その他のお客様はお座りのままお待ちください。 → つまり、後方の席の人だけ。
items.speaker: orville
choices: Only people at the back of the plane can board now.
Everyone can board the plane now.
Passengers in row 30 need to change seats.
items.note: rows 30 and higher＝30列目以降（機体の後方）
items.tts: At this time, we'd like to invite passengers seated in rows thirty and higher to board. All other passengers, please remain seated.

items.en: In a few words, please tell me the reason for your call. For example, you can say 'check my balance' or 'report a problem'.
items.ja: ご用件をひとことでお話しください。たとえば「残高確認」や「問題の報告」などとお話しいただけます。 → 「問題の報告。」
items.speaker: maple
items.note: 自動音声には用件だけを短く言う

items.en: Station office. Have you tried tapping your card again on the yellow reader?
items.ja: 駅事務室です。黄色の読み取り機にもう一度カードをタッチしてみましたか？ →「はい、2回。まだエラーが出ます。」
items.speaker: julian
choices: Yes, twice. It still says error.
No, I don't have a yellow card.
items.note: Have you tried ~ing?＝〜してみた？ 経験の有無

items.en: Passenger Kenji Mori, traveling to Bangkok, please identify yourself to a gate agent at gate 22.
items.ja: バンコク行きのモリ・ケンジ様、22番ゲートの係員までお申し出ください。 →「モリです。呼び出されたと思います。」
items.speaker: coco
choices: Hi, I'm Kenji Mori. I think you paged me.
items.note: identify yourself＝名乗り出る。呼び出し放送
items.tts: Passenger Kenji Mori, traveling to Bangkok, please identify yourself to a gate agent at gate twenty-two.

items.en: Hi, you've reached Dr. Rivera's office. We're closed for lunch until 2. Please leave your name, your number and a short message after the tone.
items.ja: リベラ医院です。2時まで昼休みです。発信音の後に、お名前、電話番号、ご用件をどうぞ。 →「ケン・モリです。予約のことで折り返しお願いします。」
items.speaker: goldie
choices: Hi, this is Ken Mori. Could you call me back about an appointment?
Hi, I'll have lunch at two, then.
Hello? Dr. Rivera? Are you there?
items.note: after the tone＝発信音の後。名前・番号・用件
items.tts: Hi, you've reached Doctor Rivera's office. We're closed for lunch until two. Please leave your name, your number and a short message after the tone.

items.en: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Did you say 'cancel my order'?
items.ja: すみません、聞き取れませんでした。「注文のキャンセル」とおっしゃいましたか？ →「いいえ、注文の変更です。」
items.speaker: bunnie
items.note: 自動音声の確認。違うときは No と正しい用件

items.en: Sorry, buddy, this train's not in service. You'll want the next one, on track 2.
items.ja: すみません、この電車は回送です。次の電車に乗ってください、2番線です。 →「あ、すみません。2番線ですね？」
items.speaker: sherb
choices: I'll want the last one, then.
items.note: not in service＝回送。buddy は気さくな呼びかけ
items.tts: Sorry, buddy, this train's not in service. You'll want the next one, on track two.
